title: Nested if se final complex problem
solution:
function processOrder(quantity, price, isMember) {
  if (quantity <= 0 || price <= 0) return "Invalid order"
  let total = quantity * price
  if (isMember) total *= 0.8
  if (total > 5000) total *= 0.95
  return total
}
